body.statement: For a canonical LV-SEM-ME satisfying Yang et al.'s LV-SEM-ME faithfulness and minimality conditions, Algorithm 1 returns its ancestral ordered grouping as a partition in causal group order, Algorithm 2 enumerates the legal ancestral-ordered-group reconstructions, and the minimum-edge output of Algorithm 2 is exactly its DOG equivalence class on the probability-one domain of Theorem 3.

source.locator: Definition 7, Algorithm 1, Algorithm 2, Theorem 3(2), and Proposition 7(2)

attestation.note: Checked directly against the cited definition, algorithms, theorem, and proposition in the published-source manuscript.
